previews.title: Bank
previews.note: The bank as one window: 24 slots and its bags in one grid, the bag slots and Purchase, the bank as last seen. A Tauren druid and a Dwarf hunter.

previews.title: The Book Reader
previews.note: Books, letters and plaques: Forever UI’s book window with each page’s material, DialogueUI’s book view, the list by zone with search.

previews.title: Calendar
previews.note: The world’s events: holidays with their art, the Darkmoon Faire’s cycle, the fishing contest, Calls to Arms, raid resets; each event’s details and quests.

previews.title: Collections
previews.note: Mounts and companions in Forever’s Collections window: the list with search and filters, the detail with source, lore and the model in the Dressing Room.

previews.title: Guild & Communities
previews.note: The roster (sorting, offline members), Chat, Guild Info and the Log; the window for a character in no guild. The Wayfarers of Mulgore and of Dun Morogh.

previews.title: Loot
previews.note: The loot window (cards, the title by what is looted), the loot and money toasts, the group loot roll.

previews.title: Spellbook
previews.note: Forever’s parchment: the spells by tab, 2 or 3 columns, search, the spells not learned yet, the settings on the portrait. Tauren and Night Elf druids, a Tauren shaman, a Dwarf paladin.

previews.title: Talent calculator
previews.note: Every class’s trees on the Talents window’s parts: the three trees at once or one at a time, a level and its points, the game’s rules, Undo / Redo, a build to share by its link, the summary.

previews.title: Flight Map
previews.note: The flight map: the continent’s taxi map, the flight points found, the routes and their prices. Thunder Bluff and Ironforge.

previews.title: The Trainer
previews.note: A class trainer and a profession trainer: greeting, rank bar and skill step, the services by skill line with costs and requirements, Train; Thunder Bluff and Darnassus.

previews.title: Quest Frames
previews.note: The quest giver’s window: greeting, details, progress and reward with real quests, their objectives and rewards. Mulgore and Dun Morogh.

previews.title: The attribute tooltips
previews.note: Every stat tooltip as the game draws it (0.235.19) beside the study’s looks.

previews.title: Group Finder
previews.note: Forever UI’s Group Finder in place of Looking for Group: role, dungeon, bots from the world and made ones, the way there; battlegrounds from anywhere.

previews.title: Bring My Group
previews.note: A button over the party frames in a dungeon: the lead from a bot, then the whole group to you.

previews.title: Buff tooltips
previews.note: Your buffs’ numbers as your talents make them (F0058), green where raised.

previews.title: Friends
previews.note: Contacts (status, Gametag, friends and ignore lists), Who and Raid in Camelot’s metal; a Horde and an Alliance character.

previews.title: The Beast Journal
previews.note: The hunter’s journal in the Adventure Journal: its pages (blank ones with their hints), beasts by role and family, skills from beasts, the beast and rank cards; a Tauren and a Night Elf hunter.

previews.title: The Adventure Journal
previews.note: The Adventurer’s Journey (acts, training, milestones, dungeons), the Challenges and their points, the Progress Track, the Journals; a Tauren and a Night Elf hunter.

previews.title: The Dungeon Journal
previews.note: Retail’s Adventure Guide for vanilla: every dungeon and raid from the server’s data (226 bosses), The Deadmines and Wailing Caverns in our words; delves art on or off.

previews.title: The Pet Stable
previews.note: The stables on Forever’s new art: the pet, its XP, the slots, Purchase and its question; Thunder Bluff and Darnassus.

previews.title: Mail
previews.note: The inbox, the open letter (an invoice, a letter, attachments) and Send Mail. Thunder Bluff and Ironforge letters.

previews.title: AddOn List
previews.note: Forever’s AddOn List with your addons grouped (modules under their addon) in categories that fold; search, Right-click menu, a character’s states, Reload UI.

previews.title: Battlegrounds
previews.note: The battlemaster’s queue in Camelot’s metal (SkinLFG.lua): the instances, the description on parchment, Join as Group, Join Battle.

previews.title: Auction House
previews.note: The auction house: Browse by item category (classicdb’s menu), search, level, rarity, usable, sortable columns, bid and buyout; Bids; Auctions with the deposit. Horde, Alliance and neutral houses.

previews.title: Options
previews.note: The Options window: Gameplay and System categories, every page’s settings working (checks, sliders, dropdowns), two columns, the Mac / Windows switch, graphics presets, search.

previews.title: Key Bindings
previews.note: A Mac or Windows keyboard with every key’s action, the mouse and the controller views (drawn or Branded), the layers, Forever’s action list with search, binding that works.

previews.title: Social (Forever’s new Friends window)
previews.note: Friends, Recent Allies, Friend Requests and Raid as side tabs, Forever 1.60.1’s layout fed by 1.14.2; a Horde and an Alliance character.

previews.title: Lore option 4
previews.note: Newer scholarship in the world, ten proposals for the user to pick.

previews.title: Game Menu
previews.note: Escape’s menu in the diamond-metal dialog: Options, Key Bindings, Customize Interface, Macros, Testing Suite, Logout, Exit Game (it asks first), Return to Game.

previews.title: GM Testing Suite playground
previews.note: The suite’s eleven command patterns as cards, and the window’s pages (Cooking, Reputation, GM modes…) in layouts A and B2; today’s hubs or the proposed Test tab.

previews.title: The kit
previews.note: Every shared piece: the chrome, the tabs, buttons, menus, search, checks, item buttons, coins, bars, lists, the scroll bar, the tooltip, dialogs, sliders, the quest tiles, the tooltip blocks.

previews.title: Merchant
previews.note: The merchant window: items and prices, paging, repair and Sell All Junk, the buyback slot and tab, the greeting. Thunder Bluff and Ironforge merchants.

previews.title: Shop and Micro Menu
previews.note: The Shop’s item cards with Buy (it asks first) and the micro menu bar: Forever’s eleven buttons, their states and tooltips.

previews.title: Forever Launcher
previews.note: The server launcher: the intro and the changelog, the services and the log, the settings.

previews.title: Dressing Room
previews.note: The game’s gear tried on the game’s characters (1.14.2’s models, every race of both factions), with each zone’s quest rewards and drops, each dungeon’s and raid’s bosses and the item sets beside it; and the creatures: beasts, bosses and NPCs in their own models, by zone, dungeon, raid and kind.

previews.title: Talents
previews.note: One tree on its Classic painting or the three on the class’s own; Forever’s nodes, arrows, the plan and Apply Changes, the clouds. Tauren and Night Elf druids, a Tauren shaman, a Dwarf paladin.

previews.title: World Map & Quest Log
previews.note: The map with Forever’s art, zones and pins, the nav bar, the quest log with its details. The Barrens and the Wetlands.

previews.title: Companions
previews.note: every companion: where it comes from, by source, each in 3D (the Dressing Room’s viewer)

previews.title: Inspect
previews.note: The inspected player’s gear and model with View Talents, Honor, their talents (read only), professions and pet; a Horde and an Alliance character.

previews.title: Combo Points
previews.note: The target frame’s combo points: 1.14.2’s pips in Forever’s old arc beside WoW Forever 70291’s gems round the portrait.

previews.title: WoW Forever 70291 in Forever UI
previews.note: The three changes from Forever’s 1.60.1.70291 build: quest types in the tracker and log, buffed stats, View Talents. With the quest tracker. Step four’s previews: inspect side tabs, combo points, the level line.

previews.title: Place Objects (preview)
previews.note: The GM’s decorating window: the catalogue by side, people and kind with the model turning, the object in hand (Nearest, Place and Move ahead, nudge, turn, Shrink Me, Delete) and the session’s changes with Undo; the commands shown, nothing sent.

previews.title: Dialogue Frame Sizes
previews.note: DialogueUI’s frame in three heights picked from its content: Small, Medium and Large; a slider to grow the text and watch it step.

previews.title: The Lockpicking Journal
previews.note: The rogues’ tab: where to practice by skill band, the lockboxes, chests and doors by skill and place, the trainers’ practice places with map pins, the lock pass greyed; a Night Elf and an Undead rogue (sample counts).

previews.title: Lockpicking’s Ranks
previews.note: The lockpicking rework (preview): the journal with ranks, the rank quests in DialogueUI, the timed test, the rank-up banner and a standing banner, Ravenholdt’s reputation, the practice places before and after.

previews.title: The Rogue’s Journal
previews.note: The redesigned rogue’s journal (preview): the Journey to Artisan, lockboxes from pockets and from the fallen with the reworked contents, the trainers’ counter and fee, pickpocketing by level and type, your record.

previews.title: Bags
previews.note: The combined backpack (10 columns from the bottom right, Clean Up, search, money, the bag colors) and the keyring. A Tauren druid and a Dwarf hunter.

previews.title: Box Drops
previews.note: Everything in the junkboxes, lockboxes and locked chests, in tabs by kind, with each box’s chance.

previews.title: Guild Crest
previews.note: The guild crest as a grid of emblem pictures, the crest large beside it.

previews.title: Macros
previews.note: Your macros, the Library, the Builder (blocks, chips, the light, Right now) and the Macro Guide beside; a Tauren druid, an Undead warlock, a Night Elf hunter, a Dwarf paladin.

previews.title: PvP Reward Vendors
previews.note: The rank quartermasters and the battlegrounds’ supply officers in the merchant window: icons, tooltips with the rank or standing each item asks for, Filter, buying.

previews.title: Mounts
previews.note: every mount: where it comes from and who may ride it, by source, each in 3D (the Dressing Room’s viewer)

previews.title: Reputation Pane Study
previews.note: The detail pane’s new format: lore line, introduction, facts, three layouts.

previews.title: Skills Tab Study
previews.note: The Skills tab’s new format: names, ranks, icons, weapon, riding and armor panes.

previews.title: The Gathering Journals
previews.note: The Herbalist’s, Miner’s, Skinner’s and Angler’s journals: the list by zone and material, the card (here, gathered, where it grows or bites), the Filter; a Tauren and a Night Elf hunter.

previews.title: Professions
previews.note: The book (two primary cards, three secondary) and every profession’s crafting page: categories, Filter, search, the recipe card with its reagents and sources, Create; four characters of both factions.

previews.title: The Weapon “i”
previews.note: The weapon tooltip’s wielders, trainers, racial bonuses and class talents, for six characters.

previews.title: Character
previews.note: The paper doll and its stats (tooltips, equipment sets, titles), Reputation, Skills, PvP, Currency and Statistics; a Horde and an Alliance character.
